capability: Compare repository, platform and installed solutions before adding a dependency
evidence: Source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/tree/96608e078b2d5ea607c5c3b8b5a54d1c1fba6846. Read README, root MIT license, primary/review skills and behavior-test source as untrusted text; fetched file bytes matched Git blob hashes. No source code, installers, hooks or model API were run.

Searched canonical skills, rules and agents. Simplicity, caller tracing and behavior-preserving cleanup are already owned by coding-standards, change-impact and code-simplifier. TypeScript and Bun have language-specific built-in preferences; native copies are not separate capabilities.

The generic search-first Quick Mode went from repository search directly to package search. Its decision matrix lacked a comparison with compatible platform features and installed dependencies. Added that checkpoint, preserving project conventions, runtime/semantic requirements and required checks; refreshed its Codex projection through the maintained helper.

An independent raw-fixture forward-test chose the existing request-ID helper, configured nested-query parser and audited HTTP client; chose the standard JSON reader for a compatible simple CLI; deferred a signature library pending provenance, trust-policy and adversarial checks. Five instruction-level decisions, not application runtime tests or measured dependency savings.
reason: Extend the existing dependency-selection owner rather than introducing a broad simplicity skill or adopting a persona. The change supplies a concrete missing choice point without equating fewer dependencies with correctness or authorizing installation.
